		max = {
			value = 0

tv_trade_set_embargo_horses = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_horses ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_horses ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_horses ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_horses ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_horses ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_horses value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_horses value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_horses value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_horses value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_clay = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_clay ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_clay ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_clay ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_clay ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_clay ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_clay
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_clay ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_clay
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_clay ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_clay_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_clay value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_clay value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_clay value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_clay value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_clay_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_embargo_clay = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_clay ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_clay ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_clay ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_clay ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_clay ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_clay value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_clay value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_clay value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_clay value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

	type = owncountry

	show_message = yes

		scope:actor = {

				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league

		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_sand ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_sand ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_sand ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_sand ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_sand
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_sand ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_sand
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_sand ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_sand_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_sand value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_sand value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_sand value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_sand value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_sand_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

tv_trade_set_embargo_sand = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {

		}

				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_sand ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_sand ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_sand ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_sand ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_sand value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_sand value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_sand value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_sand value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

	type = owncountry

	show_message = yes

		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league

		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_coal ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_coal ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_coal ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_coal ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_coal
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_coal ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_coal
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_coal ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_coal_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_coal value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_coal value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_coal value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_coal value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_coal_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_coal value = 0 }

tv_trade_set_embargo_coal = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_coal ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_coal ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_coal ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_coal ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_coal ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_coal value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_coal value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_coal value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_coal value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_iron ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_iron ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_iron ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_iron ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_iron
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_iron ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_iron
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_iron ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_iron_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_iron value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_iron value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_iron value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_iron value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_iron_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

tv_trade_set_embargo_iron = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_iron ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_iron ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_iron ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_iron ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_iron ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_iron value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_iron value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_iron value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_iron value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_copper = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_copper ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_copper ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_copper ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_copper ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_copper ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_copper
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_copper ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_copper
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_copper ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_copper_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_copper value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_copper value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_copper value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_copper value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_copper_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_embargo_copper = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_copper ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_copper ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_copper ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_copper ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_copper ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_copper value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_copper value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_copper value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_copper value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_goods_gold ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_goods_gold ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target

		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"

		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {

					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_goods_gold ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_goods_gold
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_goods_gold ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_goods_gold

		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}

				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}

				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_goods_gold ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_goods_gold_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_goods_gold value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_goods_gold value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_goods_gold value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_goods_gold value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }

tv_trade_set_embargo_goods_gold = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_goods_gold ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_goods_gold ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_goods_gold ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_goods_gold ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_goods_gold ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_goods_gold value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_goods_gold value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_goods_gold value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_goods_gold value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_embargo_silver = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_silver ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_silver ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_silver ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_silver ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_silver ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_silver value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_silver value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_silver value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_silver value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_embargo_stone = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_stone ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_stone ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_stone ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_stone ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_stone ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_stone value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_stone value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_stone value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_stone value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_tin ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_tin ?= { this >= 1 }

				limit = {
					any_international_organizations_member_of = {

					}
					var:tv_trade_monopoly_tin ?= { this >= 1 }

			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_tin ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tin ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_tin ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }

							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_tin ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_tin value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_tin value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_tin value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_tin value = scope:target_1 }

			}
		}
	}

				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_lead ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_lead ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_lead ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"

		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }

	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_lead ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_lead
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_lead ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_lead
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_lead ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_lead_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_lead value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_lead value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_lead value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_lead value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_lead_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}

			var:tv_trade_monopoly_lead ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_lead ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_lead ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"

		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes

					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_lead value = 30 }

		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_silk ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_silk
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_silk ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_silk
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_silk ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_silk_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_silk value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_silk value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_silk value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_silk value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_silk_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

		}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_silk ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_silk ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_silk ?= { this >= 5 }
		}

				limit = {
					any_international_organizations_member_of = {
						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
						leader_country ?= scope:actor
					}
					var:tv_trade_monopoly_silk ?= { this >= 1 }
					var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_silk ?= { this >= 1 }

				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_silk ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}

		target_flag = target

		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no

		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }

			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes

			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_dyes ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_dyes ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_dyes ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_dyes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_dyes ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_dyes
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_dyes ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_dyes_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_dyes value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_dyes value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_dyes value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_dyes value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_dyes_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_dyes ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_dyes ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_dyes ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_dyes ?= { this >= 5 }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_international_organizations_member_of = {
						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
						leader_country ?= scope:actor
					}
					var:tv_trade_monopoly_dyes ?= { this >= 1 }
					var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_dyes ?= { this >= 1 }
				}
				tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_dyes_effect = yes
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_dyes add = 5 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_dyes add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_dyes <= 0 }

					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_dyes value = 0 }

				}
				else = {
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_dyes_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}

	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }

	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_incense ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_incense ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_incense ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_incense ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_incense ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_incense
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_incense ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_incense
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_incense ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_incense_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_incense value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_incense value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_incense value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_incense value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_incense_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_increase_virtual_supply_incense = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_incense ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_incense ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_incense ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_incense ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_incense ?= { this >= 5 }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_international_organizations_member_of = {
						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
						leader_country ?= scope:actor
					}
					var:tv_trade_monopoly_incense ?= { this >= 1 }
					var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_incense ?= { this >= 1 }
				}
				tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_incense_effect = yes
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_incense add = 5 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_incense add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_incense <= 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_incense value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_incense value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_incense value = 0 }
					remove_variable = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_incense
				}
				else = {
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_incense_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

			var:tv_trade_monopoly_incense ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_incense ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_incense ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"

		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target

						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_incense ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_incense value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_incense value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_incense value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }

			}

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_tea = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_tea ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_tea ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tea ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_tea ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tea ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tea
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_tea ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_tea
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_tea ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_tea_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_tea value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_tea value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_tea value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_tea value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_tea_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_tea ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_tea ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_tea ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_tea ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tea ?= { this >= 5 }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_international_organizations_member_of = {
						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
						leader_country ?= scope:actor
					}
					var:tv_trade_monopoly_tea ?= { this >= 1 }
					var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_tea ?= { this >= 1 }
				}
				tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_tea_effect = yes
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_tea add = 5 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_tea add = 1 }

					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_tea value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_tea value = 0 }

				}
				else = {
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_tea_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}

	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_cocoa = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_cocoa ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_cocoa ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cocoa ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_cocoa ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cocoa ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cocoa
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_cocoa ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_cocoa
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_cocoa ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_cocoa_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_cocoa value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_cocoa value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_cocoa value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_cocoa value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_cocoa_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_coffee = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_coffee ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_coffee ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_coffee ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_coffee ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_coffee ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_coffee
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_coffee ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_coffee
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_coffee ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_coffee_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_coffee value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_coffee value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_coffee value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_coffee value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_coffee_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_fiber_crops ?= { this >= 1 } }

			}

			}

					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_fiber_crops value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_ivory = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_ivory ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_ivory ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_ivory ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_ivory ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_ivory ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_ivory
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_ivory ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_ivory
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_ivory ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_ivory_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_ivory value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_ivory value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_ivory value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_ivory value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_ivory_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_lumber = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_lumber ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_lumber ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_lumber ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_lumber ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_lumber ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_lumber
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_lumber ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_lumber
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_lumber ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_lumber_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_lumber value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_lumber value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_lumber value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_lumber value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_lumber_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_salt = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_salt ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_salt ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_salt ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_salt ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_salt ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_salt
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_salt ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_salt
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_salt ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_salt_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_salt value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_salt value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_salt value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_salt value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_salt_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_medicaments = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_medicaments ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_medicaments ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_medicaments ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_medicaments ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_medicaments ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_medicaments
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_medicaments ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_medicaments
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_medicaments ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_medicaments_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_medicaments value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_medicaments value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_medicaments value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_medicaments value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_medicaments_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_pearls ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_pearls
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_pearls ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_pearls
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_pearls ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_pearls_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_pearls value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_pearls value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_pearls value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_pearls value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_pearls_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_amber ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_amber ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_amber ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_amber ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_amber ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_amber
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_amber ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_amber
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_amber ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_amber_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_amber value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_amber value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_amber value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_amber value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_amber_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_increase_virtual_demand_amber = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_amber ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_amber ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_amber ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_amber ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_amber ?= { this >= 5 }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_international_organizations_member_of = {
						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
						leader_country ?= scope:actor
					}
					var:tv_trade_monopoly_amber ?= { this >= 1 }
					var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_amber ?= { this >= 1 }
				}
				tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_amber_effect = yes
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_amber add = 5 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_amber add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_amber <= 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_amber value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_amber value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_amber value = 0 }
					remove_variable = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_amber
				}
				else = {
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_amber_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}
