tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_saltpeter = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_saltpeter ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_saltpeter ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_saltpeter ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_saltpeter ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_saltpeter ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_saltpeter
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_saltpeter ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_saltpeter
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_saltpeter ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_saltpeter_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_saltpeter value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_saltpeter value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_saltpeter value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_saltpeter value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_saltpeter_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_alum = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_alum ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_alum ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_alum ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_alum ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_alum ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_alum
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_alum ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_alum
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_alum ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_alum_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_alum value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_alum value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_alum value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_alum value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_alum_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_wine = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_wine ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_wine ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wine ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wine ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wine ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wine
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wine ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_wine
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_wine ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_wine_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wine value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_wine value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_wine value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_wine value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_wine_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_increase_virtual_demand_wine = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {

			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_wine ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wine ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_wine ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wine ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wine ?= { this >= 5 }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_international_organizations_member_of = {
						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
						leader_country ?= scope:actor
					}
					var:tv_trade_monopoly_wine ?= { this >= 1 }
					var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wine ?= { this >= 1 }
				}
				tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_wine_effect = yes
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_wine add = 5 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_wine add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_wine <= 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wine value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_wine value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_wine value = 0 }
					remove_variable = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_wine
				}
				else = {
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_wine_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_elephants = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_elephants ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_elephants ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_elephants ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_elephants ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_elephants ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_elephants
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_elephants ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_elephants
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_elephants ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_elephants_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_elephants value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_elephants value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_elephants value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_elephants value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_elephants_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_marble = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_marble ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_marble ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_marble ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_marble ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_marble ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_marble
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_marble ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_marble
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_marble ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_marble_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_marble value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_marble value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_marble value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_marble value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_marble_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_mercury = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_mercury ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_mercury ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_mercury ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_mercury ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_mercury ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_mercury
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_mercury ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_mercury
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_mercury ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_mercury_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_mercury value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_mercury value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_mercury value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_mercury value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_mercury_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_mercury ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_mercury ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}

		target_flag = target

		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"

		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }

	}

		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_saffron = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_saffron ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_saffron ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_saffron ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_saffron ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_saffron ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_saffron
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_saffron ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_saffron
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_saffron ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_saffron_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_saffron value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_saffron value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_saffron value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_saffron value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_saffron_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_pepper = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_pepper ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_pepper ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_pepper ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_pepper ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_pepper ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_pepper
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_pepper ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_pepper
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_pepper ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_pepper_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_pepper value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_pepper value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_pepper value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_pepper value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_pepper_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_pepper ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_pepper ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_pepper ?= { this >= 5 }
		}
	}

			if = {
				limit = {

						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league

					}
					var:tv_trade_monopoly_pepper ?= { this >= 1 }
					var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_pepper ?= { this >= 1 }

				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_pepper add = 5 }

				}
				else = {

				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_cloves = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_cloves ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_cloves ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cloves ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_cloves ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cloves ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cloves
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_cloves ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_cloves
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_cloves ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_cloves_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_cloves value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_cloves value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_cloves value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_cloves value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_cloves_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_embargo_cloves = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_cloves ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_cloves ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cloves ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_cloves ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_cloves ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_cloves value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_cloves value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_cloves value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_cloves value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_chili = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_chili ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_chili ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_chili ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_chili ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_chili ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_chili
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_chili ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_chili
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_chili ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_chili_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_chili value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_chili value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_chili value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_chili value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_chili_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_embargo_chili = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_chili ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_chili ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_chili ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_chili ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_chili ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_chili value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_chili value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_chili value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_chili value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_cotton = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_cotton ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_cotton ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cotton ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_cotton ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cotton ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cotton
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_cotton ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_cotton
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_cotton ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_cotton_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_cotton value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_cotton value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_cotton value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_cotton value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_cotton_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_sugar ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_sugar ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_sugar ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_sugar ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_sugar ?= { this >= 5 }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_international_organizations_member_of = {
						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
						leader_country ?= scope:actor
					}
					var:tv_trade_monopoly_sugar ?= { this >= 1 }
					var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_sugar ?= { this >= 1 }
				}
				tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_sugar_effect = yes
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_sugar subtract = 5 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_sugar subtract = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_sugar <= 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_sugar value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_sugar value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_sugar value = 0 }
					remove_variable = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_sugar
				}
				else = {
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_sugar_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_embargo_sugar = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_sugar ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_sugar ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_sugar ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_sugar ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_sugar ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_sugar value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_sugar value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_sugar value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_sugar value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_tobacco = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_tobacco ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_tobacco ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tobacco ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_tobacco ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tobacco ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tobacco
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_tobacco ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_tobacco
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_tobacco ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_tobacco_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_tobacco value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_tobacco value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_tobacco value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_tobacco value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_tobacco_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_tobacco ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tobacco ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_tobacco ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {

			limit = {
				exists = scope:target

			}

					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_tobacco value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_tobacco value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_tobacco value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_tobacco value = scope:target_1 }

			}
		}
	}

tv_trade_set_embargo_tar = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_tar ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_tar ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tar ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_tar ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_tar ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_tar value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_tar value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_tar value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_tar value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_porcelain ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_porcelain ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_porcelain ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"

	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_porcelain ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_porcelain
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_porcelain ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_porcelain
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_porcelain ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_porcelain_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_porcelain value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_porcelain value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_porcelain value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_porcelain value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }

tv_trade_set_embargo_porcelain = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_porcelain ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_porcelain ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_porcelain ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_porcelain ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_porcelain ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_porcelain value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_porcelain value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_porcelain value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_porcelain value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_naval_supplies = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_naval_supplies ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_naval_supplies ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_naval_supplies ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_naval_supplies ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_naval_supplies ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_naval_supplies
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_naval_supplies ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_naval_supplies
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_naval_supplies ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_naval_supplies_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_naval_supplies value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_naval_supplies value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_naval_supplies value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_naval_supplies value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_naval_supplies_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_cannons = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_cannons ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_cannons ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cannons ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_cannons ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cannons ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cannons
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_cannons ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_cannons
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_cannons ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_cannons_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_cannons value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_cannons value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_cannons value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_cannons value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_cannons_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_weaponry = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_weaponry ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_weaponry ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_weaponry ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_weaponry ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_weaponry ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_weaponry
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_weaponry ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_weaponry
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_weaponry ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_weaponry_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_weaponry value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_weaponry value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_weaponry value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_weaponry value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_weaponry_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_increase_virtual_supply_weaponry = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_weaponry ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_weaponry ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_weaponry ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_weaponry ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_weaponry ?= { this >= 5 }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_international_organizations_member_of = {
						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
						leader_country ?= scope:actor
					}
					var:tv_trade_monopoly_weaponry ?= { this >= 1 }
					var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_weaponry ?= { this >= 1 }
				}
				tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_weaponry_effect = yes
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_weaponry add = 5 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_weaponry add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_weaponry <= 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_weaponry value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_weaponry value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_weaponry value = 0 }
					remove_variable = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_weaponry
				}
				else = {
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_weaponry_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_glass = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_glass ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_glass ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_glass ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_glass ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_glass ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_glass
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_glass ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_glass
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_glass ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_glass_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_glass value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_glass value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_glass value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_glass value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_glass_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_steel = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_steel ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_steel ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_steel ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_steel ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_steel ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_steel
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_steel ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_steel
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_steel ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_steel_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_steel value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_steel value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_steel value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_steel value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_steel_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_cloth = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_cloth ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_cloth ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cloth ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_cloth ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cloth ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_cloth
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_cloth ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_cloth
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_cloth ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_cloth_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_cloth value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_cloth value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_cloth value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_cloth value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_cloth_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_fine_cloth = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_fine_cloth ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_fine_cloth ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fine_cloth ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_fine_cloth ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fine_cloth ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fine_cloth
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_fine_cloth ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_fine_cloth
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_fine_cloth ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_fine_cloth_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_fine_cloth value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_fine_cloth value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_fine_cloth value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_fine_cloth value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_fine_cloth_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_liquor = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_liquor ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_liquor ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_liquor ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_liquor ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_liquor ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_liquor
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_liquor ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_liquor
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_liquor ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_liquor_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_liquor value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_liquor value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_liquor value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_liquor value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_liquor_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}
