tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_beer = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_beer ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_beer ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_beer ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_beer ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_beer ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_beer
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_beer ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_beer
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_beer ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_beer_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_beer value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_beer value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_beer value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_beer value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_beer_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_paper = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_paper ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_paper ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_paper ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_paper ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_paper ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_paper
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_paper ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_paper
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_paper ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_paper_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_paper value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_paper value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_paper value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_paper value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_paper_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {

				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_books ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_books ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_books ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_books ?= { this >= 1 }

				limit = {
					any_international_organizations_member_of = {
						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league

					}
					var:tv_trade_monopoly_books ?= { this >= 1 }
					var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_books ?= { this >= 1 }

				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_books add = 1 }

					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_books value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_books value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_books value = 0 }

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_books = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_books ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_books ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_books ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_books ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_books ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_books
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_books ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_books
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_books ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_books_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_books value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_books value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_books value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_books value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_books_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_jewelry = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_jewelry ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_jewelry ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_jewelry ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_jewelry ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_jewelry ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_jewelry
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_jewelry ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_jewelry
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_jewelry ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_jewelry_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_jewelry value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_jewelry value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_jewelry value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_jewelry value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_jewelry_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_tools ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_tools ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tools ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_tools ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tools ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tools
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_tools ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_tools
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_tools ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_tools_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_tools value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_tools value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_tools value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_tools value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_tools_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never

	potential = {

				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_tools ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_tools ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_tools ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_tools ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_tools ?= { this >= 5 }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_international_organizations_member_of = {
						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
						leader_country ?= scope:actor
					}
					var:tv_trade_monopoly_tools ?= { this >= 1 }
					var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_tools ?= { this >= 1 }
				}
				tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_tools_effect = yes
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_tools add = 5 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_tools add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_tools <= 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_tools value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_tools value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_tools value = 0 }
					remove_variable = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_tools
				}
				else = {
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_tools_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_masonry = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_masonry ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_masonry ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_masonry ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_masonry ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_masonry ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_masonry
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_masonry ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_masonry
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_masonry ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_masonry_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_masonry value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_masonry value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_masonry value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_masonry value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_masonry_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_pottery = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_pottery ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_pottery ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_pottery ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_pottery ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_pottery ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_pottery
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_pottery ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_pottery
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_pottery ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_pottery_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_pottery value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_pottery value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_pottery value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_pottery value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_pottery_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_furniture = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_furniture ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_furniture ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_furniture ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_furniture ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_furniture ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_furniture
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_furniture ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_furniture
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_furniture ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_furniture_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_furniture value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_furniture value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_furniture value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_furniture value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_furniture_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_increase_virtual_demand_furniture = {

		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_furniture ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_furniture ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_furniture ?= { this >= 5 }
		}

	effect = {

			if = {
				limit = {
					any_international_organizations_member_of = {
						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
						leader_country ?= scope:actor
					}
					var:tv_trade_monopoly_furniture ?= { this >= 1 }
					var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_furniture ?= { this >= 1 }
				}
				tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_furniture_effect = yes
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_furniture add = 5 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_furniture add = 1 }

					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_furniture value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_furniture value = 0 }

				}
				else = {

				}
			}
		}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_furniture ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_furniture value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_furniture value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_furniture value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_furniture value = scope:target_1 }

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_wool = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_wool ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_wool ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wool ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wool ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wool ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wool
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wool ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_wool
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_wool ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_wool_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wool value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_wool value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_wool value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_wool value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_wool_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_increase_virtual_demand_wool = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {

				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_wool ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wool ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_wool ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wool ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wool ?= { this >= 5 }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_international_organizations_member_of = {
						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
						leader_country ?= scope:actor
					}
					var:tv_trade_monopoly_wool ?= { this >= 1 }
					var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wool ?= { this >= 1 }
				}
				tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_wool_effect = yes
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_wool add = 5 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_wool add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_wool <= 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wool value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_wool value = 0 }

					remove_variable = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_wool
				}
				else = {
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_wool_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }

				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_wild_game ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wild_game ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wild_game ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wild_game ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wild_game
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wild_game ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_wild_game
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_wild_game ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_wild_game_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wild_game value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_wild_game value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_wild_game value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_wild_game value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }

				}
			}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_fur = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_fur ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_fur ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fur ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_fur ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fur ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fur
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_fur ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_fur
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_fur ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_fur_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_fur value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_fur value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_fur value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_fur value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_fur_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

	type = owncountry

	show_message = yes

	automation_tick = never

		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league

			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_fish ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_fish ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fish ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_fish ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fish ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fish
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_fish ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_fish
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_fish ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_fish_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_fish value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_fish value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_fish value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_fish value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_fish_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_wheat = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_wheat ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_wheat ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wheat ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wheat ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wheat ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wheat
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wheat ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_wheat
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_wheat ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_wheat_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_wheat value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_wheat value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_wheat value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_wheat value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_wheat_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_embargo_wheat = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_wheat ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_wheat ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_wheat ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_wheat ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_wheat ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_wheat value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_wheat value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_wheat value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_wheat value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_maize = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_maize ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_maize ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_maize ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_maize ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_maize ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_maize
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_maize ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_maize
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_maize ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_maize_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_maize value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_maize value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_maize value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_maize value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_maize_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_increase_virtual_demand_maize = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_maize ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_maize ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_maize ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_maize ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_maize ?= { this >= 5 }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_international_organizations_member_of = {
						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
						leader_country ?= scope:actor
					}
					var:tv_trade_monopoly_maize ?= { this >= 1 }
					var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_maize ?= { this >= 1 }
				}
				tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_maize_effect = yes
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_maize add = 5 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_maize add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_maize <= 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_maize value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_maize value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_maize value = 0 }
					remove_variable = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_maize
				}
				else = {
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_maize_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_embargo_maize = {

				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_maize ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_maize ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_maize ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}

					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_maize value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_maize value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_maize value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_maize value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_rice = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_rice ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_rice ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_rice ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_rice ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_rice ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_rice
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_rice ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_rice
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_rice ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_rice_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_rice value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_rice value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_rice value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_rice value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_rice_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

			var:tv_trade_monopoly_rice ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_rice ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_rice ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"

		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {

			limit = {
				exists = scope:target

					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_rice value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_rice value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_rice value = scope:target_1 }

	type = owncountry

	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never

		scope:actor = {

		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_millet ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_millet ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_millet ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }

		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_millet ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_millet
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_millet ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_millet
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_millet ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_millet_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_millet value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_millet value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_millet value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_millet value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_millet_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }

tv_trade_set_embargo_millet = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_millet ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_millet ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_millet ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_millet ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_millet ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_millet value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_millet value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_millet value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_millet value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_legumes ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}

			value = 0

					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_legumes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_legumes ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_legumes

		default = 5
	}

			}
			scope:target = {

			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_legumes ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_legumes_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_legumes value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_legumes value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_legumes value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_legumes value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }

tv_trade_set_embargo_legumes = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_legumes ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_legumes ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_legumes ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_legumes ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_legumes ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_legumes value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_legumes value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_legumes value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_legumes value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

	type = owncountry

	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league

			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_potato ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_potato ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_potato ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_potato ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_potato ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_potato
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_potato ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_potato
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_potato ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_potato_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_potato value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_potato value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_potato value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_potato value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_potato_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_embargo_potato = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_potato ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_potato ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_potato ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_potato ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_potato ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_potato value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_potato value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_potato value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_potato value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_demand_livestock = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_livestock ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_livestock ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_livestock ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_livestock ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_livestock ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_livestock
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_livestock ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_livestock
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_livestock ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_livestock_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_livestock value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_livestock value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_livestock value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_livestock value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_livestock_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_embargo_livestock = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_livestock ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_livestock ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_livestock ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_livestock ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_livestock ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_livestock value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_livestock value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_livestock value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_livestock value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_olives ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_olives ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_olives ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_demand_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"

		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_olives ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_olives
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_olives ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_olives
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_olives ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_olives_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_olives value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_olives value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_olives value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_olives value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_olives_effect = yes
				}
			}

tv_trade_set_embargo_olives = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_olives ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_olives ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_olives ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_olives ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_olives ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_olives value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_olives value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_olives value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_olives value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}
