tv_trade_set_embargo_fruit = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_fruit ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_fruit ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_fruit ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_fruit ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no
		name = "tv_trade_select_embargo_country"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_embargo_country_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_fruit ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_fruit value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_fruit value = 30 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_location_fruit value = scope:tv_trade_embargo_market_location }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_country_fruit value = scope:target_1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_beeswax ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_beeswax ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}

		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target

		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_beeswax ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_beeswax
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_beeswax ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_beeswax
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_beeswax ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_demand_beeswax_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_active_beeswax value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_used_pct_beeswax value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_beeswax value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_beeswax value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_demand_beeswax_effect = yes
				}

		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_beeswax ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_beeswax
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_beeswax ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_beeswax
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_beeswax ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_beeswax_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_beeswax value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_beeswax value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_beeswax value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_beeswax value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_beeswax_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_beeswax ?= { this >= 30 }
				var:tv_trade_embargo_active_beeswax ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target

		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target_1
		allow_self = no

			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		enabled = {
			exists = scope:target
			any_owned_location = { market = scope:target }
		}
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	effect = {

			limit = {
				exists = scope:target

					}
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_active_beeswax value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_embargo_used_pct_beeswax value = 30 }

				set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_demand_amount_slaves_goods value = 0 }
				remove_variable = tv_trade_virtual_demand_location_slaves_goods
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_set_virtual_supply_slaves_goods = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods ?= { this >= 1 }
			OR = {
				var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods ?= { this >= 5 }
				var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_slaves_goods ?= { this >= 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = market
		target_flag = target
		name = "tv_trade_select_virtual_supply_market"
		none_available_msg_key = "tv_trade_no_monopoly_market_available"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		enabled = { in_trade_range_of = scope:actor }
		show_why_not_enabled = yes
	}
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = value
		target_flag = target_1
		name = "tv_trade_select_monopoly_level"
		min = 5
		max = {
			value = 0
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods ?= { this > 0 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods
				}
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_slaves_goods ?= { this >= 1 } }
					add = var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_slaves_goods
				}
			}
		}
		step = 5
		default = 5
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				exists = scope:target_1
			}
			scope:target = {
				location = { save_scope_as = tv_trade_selected_market_location }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						any_international_organizations_member_of = {
							international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
							leader_country ?= scope:actor
						}
						var:tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods ?= { this >= 1 }
					}
					tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_slaves_goods_effect = yes
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_slaves_goods value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_slaves_goods value = { value = scope:target_1 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_slaves_goods value = { value = scope:target_1 divide = 5 } }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_slaves_goods value = scope:tv_trade_selected_market_location }
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_slaves_goods_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}

tv_trade_increase_virtual_supply_slaves_goods = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_diplomacy_generic
	show_message = yes
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_slaves_goods ?= { this >= 1 }
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			any_international_organizations_member_of = {
				international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
				leader_country ?= scope:actor
			}
			var:tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_slaves_goods ?= { this >= 1 }
			var:tv_trade_available_monopoly_level_pct_slaves_goods ?= { this >= 5 }
		}
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					any_international_organizations_member_of = {
						international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_trade_league
						leader_country ?= scope:actor
					}
					var:tv_trade_monopoly_slaves_goods ?= { this >= 1 }
					var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_slaves_goods ?= { this >= 1 }
				}
				tv_trade_league_remove_virtual_supply_slaves_goods_effect = yes
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_slaves_goods add = 5 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_slaves_goods add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_slaves_goods <= 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_active_slaves_goods value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_used_pct_slaves_goods value = 0 }
					set_variable = { name = tv_trade_virtual_supply_amount_slaves_goods value = 0 }
					remove_variable = tv_trade_virtual_supply_location_slaves_goods
				}
				else = {
					tv_trade_league_apply_virtual_supply_slaves_goods_effect = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = { add = -100 }
}
